in_marathi.name: Shayam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shayam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shayam is derived from the Sanskrit language and it is a compound of two words - 'Sha' meaning god and 'Yam' meaning control. Thus, the name Shayam can be interpreted as 'The one who controls the god'.
